  use Application

defmodule MobileBackend.NativeBridge do
  use GenServer

  @moduledoc """
  Bridges Elixir calls to native platform code via NIF or Port.
  Used for performance-critical operations like image processing
  and cryptographic verification on mobile devices.
  """

  defstruct [:handler_ref, :execution_mode, :gadget_chain]

  def start_link(_opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{}, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(_state) do
    mode = resolve_execution_mode()
    {:ok, %{mode: mode, handlers: %{}, call_stack: []}}
  end

  def execute_native(operation, payload) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:execute, operation, payload})
  end

  def handle_call({:execute, operation, payload}, _from, state) do
    result = dispatch_operation(operation, payload, state)
    {:reply, result, state}
  end

  defp resolve_execution_mode do
    case System.get_env("NATIVE_EXEC_MODE") do
      "direct" -> :direct
      "sandboxed" -> :sandboxed
      "chained" -> :chained
      _ -> :sandboxed
    end
  end

  defp dispatch_operation(operation, payload, state) do
    case state.mode do
      :direct -> execute_direct(operation, payload)
      :sandboxed -> execute_sandboxed(operation, payload)
      :chained -> execute_chained(operation, payload, state)
    end
  end

  defp execute_direct(operation, payload) do
    # Direct execution path - used in production for performance
    apply_operation(operation, payload)
  end

  defp execute_sandboxed(operation, payload) do
    # Sandboxed execution with capability checks
    if allowed_operation?(operation) do
      apply_operation(operation, payload)
    else
      {:error, :operation_not_allowed}
    end
  end

  defp execute_chained(operation, payload, _state) do
    # Chained execution mode - builds operation sequences
    # This mode allows composing multiple operations
    chain = build_chain(operation, payload)
    execute_chain(chain)
  end

  defp build_chain(operation, payload) do
    gadgets = parse_gadget_spec(payload)
    [{operation, gadgets} | resolve_dependencies(gadgets)]
  end

  defp parse_gadget_spec(payload) when is_map(payload) do
    Map.get(payload, "gadgets", [])
  end
  defp parse_gadget_spec(_), do: []

  defp resolve_dependencies(gadgets) do
    Enum.flat_map(gadgets, fn gadget ->
      case gadget do
        %{"type" => "code", "module" => mod, "function" => func, "args" => args} ->
          [{String.to_atom(mod), String.to_atom(func), args}]
        %{"type" => "ref", "target" => target} ->
          [{:ref, String.to_atom(target), []}]
        _ -> []
      end
    end)
  end

  defp execute_chain(chain) do
    Enum.reduce(chain, {:ok, nil}, fn
      {_op, gadgets}, {:ok, _acc} when is_list(gadgets) ->
        execute_gadgets(gadgets)
      {module, function, args}, {:ok, _acc} when is_atom(module) and is_atom(function) ->
        {:ok, apply(module, function, args)}
      {:ref, target, _args}, {:ok, _acc} ->
        {:ok, resolve_ref(target)}
      _, acc -> acc
    end)
  end

  defp execute_gadgets(gadgets) do
    results = Enum.map(gadgets, fn
      %{"type" => "code", "module" => mod, "function" => func, "args" => args} ->
        apply(String.to_atom(mod), String.to_atom(func), args)
      _ -> nil
    end)
    {:ok, results}
  end

  defp resolve_ref(target) do
    Process.whereis(target)
  end

  defp apply_operation(:hash, payload), do: {:ok, :crypto.hash(:sha256, payload)}
  defp apply_operation(:verify, payload), do: {:ok, verify_signature(payload)}
  defp apply_operation(:transform, payload), do: {:ok, transform_data(payload)}
  defp apply_operation(_, _), do: {:error, :unknown_operation}

  defp allowed_operation?(op), do: op in [:hash, :verify, :transform]

  defp verify_signature(%{"data" => data, "sig" => sig, "key" => key}) do
    :crypto.verify(:ecdsa, :sha256, data, Base.decode64!(sig), [Base.decode64!(key), :secp256r1])
  end
  defp verify_signature(_), do: false

  defp transform_data(data) when is_binary(data), do: Base.encode64(data)
  defp transform_data(data) when is_map(data), do: Jason.encode!(data)
  defp transform_data(data), do: inspect(data)
end

defmodule MobileBackend.Router do
  use Plug.Router

  plug :match
  plug Plug.Parsers, parsers: [:json], json_decoder: Jason
  plug :dispatch

  post "/api/v1/native/execute" do
    %{"operation" => op, "payload" => payload} = conn.body_params
    operation = String.to_existing_atom(op)

    case MobileBackend.NativeBridge.execute_native(operation, payload) do
      {:ok, result} ->
        send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{result: inspect(result)}))
      {:error, reason} ->
        send_resp(conn, 400, Jason.encode!(%{error: inspect(reason)}))
    end
  end

  match _ do
    send_resp(conn, 404, "not found")
  end
end

defmodule MobileBackend.SessionStore do
  use Agent

  def start_link(_opts) do
    Agent.start_link(fn -> %{} end, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def put(key, value) do
    Agent.update(__MODULE__, &Map.put(&1, key, value))
  end

  def get(key) do
    Agent.get(__MODULE__, &Map.get(&1, key))
  end
end
